data.name: Yaretzi
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Yaretzi means 'God's dew.' This name is derived from the Hebrew words 'Yari' meaning 'dew' and 'Tzii' meaning 'God.' It symbolizes God's blessings and the freshness of new beginnings.
